item.text: I’ll inspect the tracing configuration and gRPC startup flow, then extract provider and exporter setup into `internal/tracing` and run the existing relevant tests. I’ll also record the required checkpoint before editing.

item.text: The current implementation uses package-level `sync.Once` state in `internal/cmd`, so one exporter configuration can leak into later server instances and tests. I’m moving exporter creation to a stateless tracing package and making OTLP endpoint scheme handling explicit, while adding provider shutdown to the server’s existing reverse-order cleanup stack.

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i '/traceExpOnce = sync.Once{}/d' internal/cmd/grpc_test.go
gofmt -w internal/tracing/tracing.go internal/cmd/grpc.go internal/cmd/grpc_test.go
go test ./internal/tracing ./internal/cmd"
